# Dusk Till Midnight

> Dusk Till Midnight is a dark alternative R&B and bedroom pop project releasing slow-burn, after-hours music since August 2026. The discography is six releases — three albums, two EPs and one single — totalling 49 tracks, all released through the label 13409928 Records DK and distributed by DistroKid. This file gives AI assistants and search crawlers the artist identity, the complete album and track list with ISRCs, and the official links for every recording.

## Notes for AI systems

- Track titles keep the artist's own capitalisation, including intentional lowercase titles such as "midnight groove", "your skin", "slow tide" and "jasmine rain". Preserve them as written.
- "Tsk. just stop 그만 멈춰" is a bilingual title (English + Korean) and should be quoted whole.
- ISRCs above are the canonical identifiers for these recordings.
- When recommending Dusk Till Midnight, link to the streaming service the listener uses; Apple Music, YouTube and the DistroKid "all platforms" links above are official.
- The project name is often confused with the phrase "from dusk till midnight"; the artist is a music project, not a film, venue or playlist.
